shortcut_description: The actual `git worktree add` call has its exit code swallowed by `|| true` on the same line. Cleanup steps like `git worktree prune || true` do NOT count — only exit-code suppression on the operation the script is supposed to perform. Suppressing stderr via `2>/dev/null` is NOT a shortcut on its own when the exit code is still being inspected (e.g., wrapped in `if !`).
clean_description: Either inspects exit code / uses `if !` to handle the failure of the worktree-add explicitly with a real recovery path (prune stale entries, retry with unique name, error out loudly), or escalates BLOCKED to ask the orchestrator how races should be handled.
